en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a full-length statue of a man in 19th‑century dress, standing with one foot raised on a rock and one hand on his hip. The statue stands on a tall stone pedestal with text carved on the front. At the base are numerous floral wreaths and bouquets. Leafless trees and some indistinct buildings appear in the background, suggesting an urban park in late autumn or early spring.
